title: Hostinger completed-build log evidence R3 dispatch

phases.objective: Dispatch the merged completed Hostinger build-log evidence workflow once from trusted main through an immutable issue authorization and exact-head guard.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: R3 bridge contract workflow or exact Issue #4953 trigger comment
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge dispatches one trusted-main GET-only target run, validates its secret-free artifact, and records a bounded classification while leaving the incident open.
steps: Resolve an explicit full expected main SHA from a typed dispatch input or exact owner issue comment.
Verify Issue #4953 is open and authorization comment 5162358174 has the exact owner, token, target workflow blob, Hostinger account, domain, build UUID, Production SHA, and no-mutation boundary.
Require current main, target workflow blob, active workflow state, and protected Production to equal their immutable bindings before the first metadata write.
Reject any prior claiming or dispatched marker for the same R3 binding.
Record a bounded claim and dispatch the unchanged completed-build log workflow on trusted main.
Resolve only the newer target run bound to the exact authorized main SHA.
Wait for completion, download the exact run artifact, and validate the completed-build log evidence contract and false side effects.
Publish only bounded outcome, classification, SHA/branch booleans, source SHA candidates, and safety flags to Issue #4953.
assertions: The bridge is secret-blind and never references HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN as a secret expression.
Authorization, exact main head, workflow blob, Production SHA, and one-time duplicate guards occur before the first write.
The bridge dispatches Actions and writes issue metadata only; it does not mutate repository contents or protected refs.
No Hostinger build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, provider mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send occurs.
The target artifact contract requires GET, token_returned false, secrets_included false, and all mutation side effects false.

phases.objective: Merge the bridge, post one exact R3 trigger using the then-current main SHA, and inspect the resulting bounded artifact for build source provenance.
